metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded using a 64-channel BioSemi system during a poetry assessment task in which participants read and rated 210 texts across seven blocks. Resting-state EEG was acquired at the beginning (trigger codes 65285, 65286) and end (trigger codes 65287, 65288) of each session. For the 4 participants in this dataset, EEG recordings were acquired in segments due to session interruptions and subsequently concatenated during preprocessing. Behavioral ratings were collected on a 7-point scale for five subjective dimensions: Aesthetic Appeal, Vivid Imagery, Being Moved, Originality, and Creativity. Psychometric assessments included mood (PANAS), personality traits (Openness, Curiosity), imagery ability (VVIQ, AVIQ), mindfulness (MAAS), and aesthetic responsiveness (AReA). Data collection occurred at the Department of Psychology, Goldsmiths University of London, UK, with ethics approval from the Local Ethics Committee. All data were anonymized with participant identifiers coded as P105, P141, P142, and P146, mapped to BIDS IDs sub-001 through sub-004 respectively.
